nom: FOREO Make My Day Hydrating UFO Activated Sheet Masks

avis.texte: I have tried every mask from this brand and a couple of other masks, but this one hydrates my skin in the best possible ways and calms down the redness especially after double cleansing. It is mandatory to always have these in stock, because it is a life saver when I travel

I've been using it consistently for two months, and my skin is loving it! It provides such great hydration that I don't want to use any other mask. This has become my weekend home spa and refreshment. The mask has helped reduce small wrinkles, leaving my face feeling firm and plump. I absolutely love how my skin looks now. Plus, it has so much liquid in it that I can repeat the treatment, making it both practical and cost-effective.

This mask calms my skin instantly. It was really hard to find something that my skin could handle without getting irritated and that's why it became dry, but this mask really is lightweight and it absorbs great. My skin is happy so far and I'' definitely repurchase

this is my 3rd purchase its an amazing pickmeup with instant results. you can get more then one use out of each pack. pkumpe and hydrates seems to sooth dine lines and subtle blur them. wish the cane in 30 packs
I like using these like once a week just for something a little extra. I think they feel nice and give me great hydration.

I love using face masks & I use a ton of different ones. These are my ultimate holy grail face masks. Definately worth every penny & would buy again & again. They make my skin feel so refreshed. 10000/10
These are great, they keep the skin looking plump and moist for a really long time after application.
Great way to start my day! In 90 seconds I give my face a nice wake up call! Pamper it before I set out for the day. Excellent quality masks!
The perfect mask to come with the UFO, it's a great introduction to the product. It worked so well for me and my skin, I'm going to try and test all the Foreo masks available.

The mask came with the UFO I bought and they're very easy to use. I love that you don't need to apply the mask with your hands and there's no need to wash it off later. The whole idea behind this type of masking is very different, and my skin feels and looks really great.

After 90 seconds of using this mask I put my hands on my face and to my surprise, my skin felt dewy with minimal residue. There is no need to rinse my skin; the majority of the mask's gel is absorbed into my skin. My skin feels better than good; it feels amazing.

This mask is very pleasant on the skin, it doesn't cause any irritation and my skin doesn't feel sticky after using it. I could even say that the mask creates some kind of barrier that protects the skin from everyday irritants. I think it's the perfect formula.
Love it; use it with the Forero UFO loved it...moisturizing !

My skin felt totally hydrated and baby smooth after using it. I especially love that it's a sheet mask bc there is no mess and no washing it off! I recommend rubbing in the extra product after the 90 sec is up!

Took me a while to make up my mind on this gadget, and I did finally. I use sheet masks all the time, tried lots and lots of different ones. It is always a hit or a miss. What I really liked about this concept is the user-friendliness and LED feature. I have been using this mask for quite some time now and I can say that I am sticking to this one. It is an investment which pays itself off in a short run.
Great mask! Effective. Priced fairly. The device you need in order to use it is quite expensive but it pays off. So happy that my search for perfect sheet mask is over!

These masks contain all the necessary ingredients. I already used different types of UFO activated masks and gravitate towards this one the mos. It feels good, it wakes up the skin and nourishes it completely, puts a protective layer over my face. The best thing is that my skin doesn't look oily after the treatment. I hardly use any liquid foundation now, it really does even out the skin tone. I LOVE it.

I just love this mask. My face is still soft after two days of using it and it really made my skin look fresh. I will definitely buy more because they are easy to use and now I love using face masks every day.

avis.titre: My go to for winter months
avis.texte: This face mask has been a lifesaver over winter. I was dubious about trying this new way of masking but I love it. I always struggle with dry patches over the colder months but a 90 sec application of this mask before my makeup totally smoothes the texture of my skin. It felt like it plumped me up and gave a shot of moisture.
These mask are remarkable good. UFO treatment is fast and I dare say maybe even moe effective than 20 minutes with conventional masks. At least in my case.
Great to start the day with, easy to use with the UFO. I'll definitely repurchase.

I like to prep my skin every morning before I put my makeup because I have a very busy day and I tend to wear makeup for more than 12 hours so this mask has been amazing. It's ultra-hydrating, it makes my skin plump and nourished. Plus, it only takes 90 sec to do it. Fabulous!

I have previously used cremes with hyaluronic acid and they were good for my skin. I tried this mask and the feeling is so wonderful. I cannot even imagine how fast those 2 minutes go bu and I often continue to apply the mask with my UFO for as long as I feel I like it and it suits me.
